overlayLab.hint: This panel sends an event. Only Studio starts audio, from a matching trigger or from a file address on the event. This page does not play audio.
overlayLab.studioMissing: Studio is not connected. Open /app in another tab of the same browser.

cooldown.expect: The second shot inside the cooldown is rejected. A cooldown of 0 has to be set on the sound.
cooldown.name: Cooldown

effects.expect: An enabled bus effect does not raise a chain error while a voice starts.
effects.name: Effects

loop.expect: If the sound loops, you confirm by listening that it keeps going.
loop.name: Loop

master-volume.expect: Studio sets the master volume to 20% and then restores it.
master-volume.name: Master volume

max-instances.expect: A burst of eight fills the limit and the rest are ignored or queued.
max-instances.name: Max instances

monitoring.expect: Phones-only mode leaves the program send off and the monitor send on.
monitoring.name: Monitoring

multiple.expect: Three events start at least two voices, or the policy stops the rest.
multiple.name: Multiple sounds

overlay-mute.expect: The voice starts and the bus meter stays at the floor.
overlay-mute.name: Overlay bus mute

play.expect: Studio finds a trigger and starts a voice. Sending the event alone does not pass.
play.name: Play overlay sound

program.expect: Monitor and program are on, and the bus is not muted.
program.name: Program routing

rapid.expect: Eight events reach Studio and at least one voice starts.
rapid.name: Rapid fire

restart.expect: Restart keeps at most one voice of that sound.
restart.name: Restart policy

stop-all.expect: After a voice starts, Stop all leaves zero instances.
stop-all.name: Stop all

overlayLab.title: Overlay Lab

verdict.cooldown-missed: The second shot started despite the cooldown.
verdict.cooldown-rejected: The second shot was rejected by the cooldown.
verdict.cooldown-unset: Cooldown is 0. Set it on the sound and run the test again.
verdict.effects-clean: An effect is enabled and the chain reported no error.
verdict.effects-error: The effect chain reported an error.
verdict.effects-none: The bus has no enabled effect. Add one in Studio and run the test again.
verdict.instances-capped: After the limit filled, later starts were ignored or queued.
verdict.instances-open: The limit is higher than the burst. Lower the instance limit and run the test again.
verdict.loop-off: The sound does not loop. Turn the loop on and confirm by ear.
verdict.loop-on: The sound loops. Confirm by ear that it does not stop after the first pass.
verdict.master-mute-failed: Studio did not store the master mute.
verdict.master-volume: Studio has the master volume at 20%.
verdict.master-volume-failed: The master volume did not reach 20%.
verdict.monitor-failed: Monitoring did not reach phones only.
verdict.monitor-on: The monitor send is on and the program send is off.
verdict.multiple-capped: A later event was ignored by the limit or the policy.
verdict.multiple-started: More than one playback started or was queued.
verdict.mute-failed: The mute does not match the bus, or the meter still shows a signal.
verdict.mute-silenced: The voice started and the bus meter stayed at the floor.
verdict.mute-unconfirmed: The bus is muted, but no voice started, so silence cannot be confirmed.
verdict.no-trigger: Studio received the event, but no enabled trigger matches it.
verdict.playback-error: Playback returned an error, such as a missing file.
verdict.playback-queued: The playback controller queued a voice.
verdict.playback-started: The playback controller started a voice.
verdict.program-failed: Program routing did not reach the expected state.
verdict.program-on: The program send and the monitor send are on.
verdict.rapid-handled: Every event in the burst reached Studio and at least one voice started.
verdict.rapid-short: Not every event in the burst came back from Studio.
verdict.restart-grew: Restart left more than one voice.
verdict.restart-held: Restart left at most one voice.
verdict.restart-other: This sound is not set to restart. Set that policy and run the test again.
verdict.stop-failed: A voice was still active after Stop all.
verdict.stopped: Stop all left no instances and no queued entry.
verdict.studio-offline: Studio is disconnected, so the path cannot be measured.
